mission_priority: XRP intelligence and prediction-engine mastery; preserve Barrot V3 as execution and verification foundation.

confirmed_facts.claim: SBI Holdings and SMFG signed a capital/business alliance on October 30, 2026; the official SBI release confirms SMFG's 5% capital participation in SBI Startale Marketing and joint research/use-case/PoC work for JPYSC and other stablecoins.
confirmed_facts.qualification: The official release does not establish production settlement, live customer use or an XRP role.

confirmed_facts.claim: SBI Shinsei Trust and SBI Clearing Trust signed a merger agreement on October 29 with December 31, 2026 as the planned effective date; SBI Clearing Trust has a crypto-asset trust custody business and SBI Shinsei Trust issues JPYSC.
confirmed_facts.qualification: The merger is not effective at this snapshot and does not identify XRP-specific custody balances.

confirmed_facts.claim: SBI completed the full acquisition of bitbank on October 1, making bitbank a wholly owned subsidiary.
confirmed_facts.qualification: Ownership does not itself establish post-acquisition changes in XRP/JPY volume or customer balances.

confirmed_facts.claim: bitbank announced an experimental local MCP server and CLI beta for AI clients, with public market data and optional private API functions.
confirmed_facts.qualification: No Barrot installation, remote service, authentication or live API call was tested.

confirmed_facts.claim: The inspected bitbank-lab-mcp source tree contains 33 public tool definitions and 16 private tools; public tools cover market data, flow, volatility, technical analysis and backtesting.
confirmed_facts.qualification: The documentation says 32 public tools in one page and 33 in others; package and Gemini extension version fields differ.

confirmed_facts.claim: bitbank-lab-mcp vendor documentation describes read-only permission for private asset inspection, read-plus-trade for order operations, no withdrawal tool, and preview/explicit-confirmation/execute order flow.
confirmed_facts.qualification: Vendor-authored design documentation is not an independent security audit; optional MCP Apps _meta execution is default-off and depends on host behavior.

confirmed_facts.claim: CoinGecko's Bitbank XRP/JPY market snapshot displayed approximately USD7.54M 24-hour volume, 0.01% spread, approximately USD354k bid-side depth and USD915k ask-side depth within ±2%.
confirmed_facts.qualification: Third-party single snapshot without an exact exchange timestamp; not a synchronized market panel.

confirmed_facts.claim: SBI's September 7 JPYSC disclosure reported approximately JPY20.1B issuance, JPY1B allocated to short-term JGBs and JPY6.9B in JPYSC lending applications.
confirmed_facts.qualification: Lending applications are not additional issued supply.

confirmed_facts.claim: SBI and Startale joined Open Standard and are considering JPYSC/OUSD interoperability; SBI, Startale and BlackRock separately signed an exploratory tokenized-MMF/JPYSC MOU.
confirmed_facts.qualification: These are exploratory arrangements; no live chain route, production settlement or XRP use is established.

confirmed_facts.claim: SBI VC Trade's XRP reward card, RLUSD/USDC distribution and SBI Ripple Asia's XRPL tokenized-deposit PoC are documented in earlier official releases.
confirmed_facts.qualification: Distribution, reward and technical-PoC announcements do not quantify XRP purchases, balances or settlement volumes.

sourced_claims.claim: NADA News, citing Nikkei, reports SMBC has approximately 24 million individual customers and that JPYSC issuance was approximately JPY20.8B on October 30.
sourced_claims.qualification: Secondary report; the official SBI release confirms the 5% stake but does not independently confirm these figures.

sourced_claims.claim: Open Standard's five named founding partners include Coinbase, Mastercard, Shopify, Stripe and Visa; a secondary report identifies Ripple among a broader participant network.
sourced_claims.qualification: Circle is not among the five named founding partners in the cited list; broader Circle participation or a direct SBI/Circle relationship is not established.

inferences.claim: SBI is assembling a multi-rail digital-asset stack spanning an acquired exchange, XRP retail distribution, XRPL technical work, JPYSC issuance, RLUSD/USDC distribution, Open Standard interoperability, tokenized-MMF exploration and consolidated trust/custody capability.
inferences.basis: Multiple official SBI, bitbank and Startale announcements. This is a group-level strategic inference; no single integrated production architecture or shared ledger is disclosed.

inferences.claim: SBI's Bitbank acquisition may increase its control over a major Japanese XRP/JPY venue and customer channel.
inferences.basis: Wholly owned acquisition and one observed XRP/JPY market snapshot. Post-acquisition volume change, customer migration and market share are not measured.

inferences.claim: SMFG's 5% participation may improve JPYSC distribution through an established banking customer base.
inferences.basis: Official 5% capital participation plus secondary reporting of SMBC's customer base. Customer count is not JPYSC adoption or committed distribution.

inferences.claim: The trust merger may combine digital-asset custody expertise with JPYSC issuance and reserve management.
inferences.basis: Official planned merger and the two entities' disclosed functions. Specific XRP custody acceptance and balances are unknown.

inferences.claim: The bitbank MCP could be a useful public-only XRP/JPY market-data adapter for Barrot and selected MCP clients.
inferences.basis: Public source registry includes ticker, order book, candles, transactions, flow/CVD and volatility tools. It is experimental, local and not connected to Barrot.

inferences.claim: SBI's stablecoin rails could complement or substitute for XRP as a JPY/USD settlement bridge; XRP remains separately distributed through exchange and reward products.
inferences.basis: JPYSC/OUSD exploration, RLUSD/USDC distribution and XRP reward products. No production route or measured substitution is established.

unknowns: Whether the planned SBI Shinsei Trust/SBI Clearing Trust merger receives all required approvals and completes on December 31.
Whether SBI Clearing Trust or the surviving trust bank accepts or holds XRP specifically, and in what amount.
Actual post-acquisition bitbank XRP/JPY customer balances, net deposits, turnover, market share and market-maker inventory.
Whether SMBC's approximately 24 million customers will receive JPYSC services and the actual number of users, balances and transactions.
Whether the secondary-reported JPY20.8B JPYSC issuance is independently reconcilable to issuer or on-chain records.
The chain, bridge, custody, redemption and settlement design for any JPYSC/OUSD interoperability pilot.
Whether the BlackRock tokenized MMF will accept JPYSC as subscription/redemption or collateral, which chain will be used and whether XRP appears in any route.
Whether Circle participates in Open Standard beyond the five founding partners cited; no direct Circle-SBI/SMFG agreement is established in the captured sources.
Whether the bitbank MCP public XRP/JPY data endpoints have been tested by Barrot, whether client support is compatible with current versions, and whether a stable release/tool manifest exists.

disconfirming_evidence.claim: SBI/SMFG and SBI/Startale announcements do not name XRP as the settlement asset for JPYSC/OUSD or SMFG use cases.
The SBI/BlackRock document is an exploratory MOU, not evidence of a live tokenized-MMF or XRP collateral flow.
SBI's XRP reward card and bond incentive establish distribution mechanisms, not XRP's use as the underlying payment or bond settlement rail.
The bitbank MCP beta has not been connected to Barrot; public repository compatibility targets do not prove live authentication or nine-platform collaboration.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SMFG's 5% participation and customer distribution capabilities will materially expand JPYSC use.
support: Official 5% capital participation and joint use-case/PoC program.
Secondary report cites approximately 24M SMBC individual customers.
counter: No active service, user count, balances by channel or settlement volumes are disclosed.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_test: No material JPYSC balance or transaction growth after launch of any SMBC distribution channel.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBI's broader financial ecosystem can increase XRP access while stablecoin rails simultaneously reduce XRP's role as a JPY/USD bridge.
support: Bitbank ownership, XRP reward products, SBI VC Trade XRP access and XRPL technical work.
JPYSC/OUSD interoperability and RLUSD/USDC distribution create alternative stablecoin rails.
counter: No production JPYSC/OUSD route or measured bridge substitution exists.
Stablecoins and XRP may serve different legs/use cases.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_test: Production settlement data shows XRP is the dominant bridge in the relevant JPY/USD routes, or stablecoin routes remain unused.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The planned SBI Shinsei Trust/SBI Clearing Trust merger will strengthen regulated digital-asset custody and stablecoin backing capabilities.
support: SBI Clearing Trust has a crypto-asset trust custody business; SBI Shinsei Trust issues JPYSC.
Official merger agreement and December 31 planned effective date.
counter: No XRP-specific custody acceptance or balance is disclosed.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_test: Regulatory approval fails, merger is delayed, or the surviving entity does not add crypto-asset custody scope.

competing_hypotheses.claim: bitbank-lab-mcp can provide Barrot with a useful Japanese XRP/JPY public market-data feed and reproducible baseline analysis.
support: Local MCP beta and public tools for ticker, order book, candles, transactions, CVD/flow and volatility.
Documented intended support for Claude Desktop, Codex and Gemini CLI.
counter: No Barrot connection or live API call tested.
Experimental beta, inconsistent tool counts and package version metadata.
Single-venue data cannot substitute for synchronized multi-venue market data.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_test: Public XRP/JPY tools fail deterministic schema/time-quality tests or cannot be pinned to a stable release.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBI's completed bitbank acquisition increases group control over Japanese XRP/JPY liquidity and customer distribution.
support: Third-party snapshot shows approximately USD7.54M 24h XRP/JPY volume and 0.01% spread.
counter: Only one third-party snapshot; no pre/post acquisition baseline or market-share panel.
Exchange volume and custody balances do not equal net XRP demand.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_test: Post-acquisition XRP/JPY volume, depth and customer balances show no durable change after controlling for market-wide volume.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBI/Startale's Open Standard participation creates an indirect ecosystem connection to Coinbase but does not establish a direct Circle partnership.
support: SBI/Startale joined Open Standard and are exploring JPYSC/OUSD.
Coinbase is named among five founding partners of Open Standard.
counter: The wider participant network may include other firms; absence from the five founders is not proof of no participation.
No direct SBI/Circle agreement or XRP settlement route is identified.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_test: A direct Circle-SBI/SMFG agreement or production Circle-issued USDC integration into the JPYSC/OUSD route is documented.
